arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -B - <<'PY' >/tmp/maxbatch2.json
import json,random,ipaddress
random.seed(1234);cases=[]
for ci in range(4):
 base=ci*(1<<110)
 initial=[["::/0",0]]
 for i in range(7):initial.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base+((i+1)<<80)))+"/128",i+1])
 initial.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address((1<<128)-1))+"/128",99])
 tx=[[]];bursts=[]
 for b in range(64):
  rep=random.randint(1,1000000);addrs=[]
  for _ in range(32):
   if random.random()<.6:
    if random.random()<.15:x=(1<<128)-1
    else:
     i=random.randrange(7);x=base+((i+1)<<80)+random.randrange(1000)
   else:x=random.getrandbits(128)
   addrs.append(str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x)))
  bursts.append({"version":b%2,"repeat":rep,"addresses":addrs})
 hit=random.randint(1,16);miss=random.randint(hit,256)
 cases.append({"initial":initial,"transactions":tx,"bursts":bursts,"cache_pages":random.randint(0,12),
               "costs":{"hit":hit,"miss":miss,"decode":[random.randint(0,16) for _ in range(3)]}})
print(json.dumps({"cases":cases},separators=(',',':')))
PY
TIMEFORMAT='elapsed %3R user %3U sys %3S'; time timeout 120 python3 -B submission/main.py < /tmp/maxbatch2.json >/tmp/maxbatch2.out 2>/tmp/maxbatch2.err; echo rc=$? err=$(head -c 300 /tmp/maxbatch2.err); ls -l /tmp/maxbatch2.out
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
x=json.load(open('/tmp/maxbatch2.out'));print('error?', 'error' in x)
for c in x.get('cases',[]):print(len(c['versions']),[len(v['starts']) for v in c['versions']],c['objective'],len(c['bursts']))
PY
